answer: Hardware attestation resists Sybil attacks by tying each agent to a secure enclave. Nodes must sign handshakes using keys fused into physical silicon. Instead of amassing a dune of virtual clones, an adversary fielding a raven swarm must purchase separate enclave chips, incurring linear hardware costs. Without valid attestation, an identity's whisper across the gossip network is rejected. However, microarchitectural side-channel flaws can leak keys, compromising hardware trust.
